instruction: Look at task-012_initial.scad. Make a twist-lock bayonet adapter. The envelope must be 64 x 64 x 36 mm. Use a lower flange of 64 mm diameter, an upper sleeve of 48 mm diameter, a 24 mm centered through bore, and three equally spaced bayonet lugs on the outside between z=10 and z=18. Each lug must protrude into the 26-32 mm radius band. Fully render and export /home/user/Desktop/task-012_output.stl. Do not create PNG, PDF, CSV, JSON, or any other extra output. You must complete all operations interactively through the graphical user interface (GUI) step by step. The use of external script files is strictly prohibited.
